title: Experts remain curators and challengers of captured knowledge
text: The CMR note gives people an ongoing role in checking cases, challenging outputs and maintaining business relevance. Capturing an expert’s reasoning is the start of a stewardship process, not evidence that the expert’s role or the need for future learning has disappeared.
qualification: Not a measured estimate of the staffing required. The exact division of expert and operator work needs local design.
